audit_item: A04 project interval authorization namespace integrity

finding.before: ProjectResearchRegistry compared market/family identifiers as raw strings without requiring canonical form. A second same-interval development record using market='ETHUSDT ' was accepted beside market='ETHUSDT', bypassing overlap detection for the same economic market.
finding.reproduction: The original registry accepted the padded-market overlap. Six newly parameterized installed-wheel cases failed before the fix: padded/lowercase market aliases and padded/mixed-case family aliases at both Registry and legacy-inventory import boundaries.

fix.registry_scope: Scope key/owner/market/family identifiers now reject surrounding whitespace; market must be uppercase and family lowercase before any database lookup or reservation.
fix.legacy_inventory_parser: The parser rejects noncanonical key, market, and family values as malformed rows.
fix.legacy_inventory_import: The direct import API independently validates key, market, and family canonical form before beginning its transaction.

verification.ruff: passed for changed source and tests
verification.mypy: passed for 2 changed source modules with RouteB workspace source paths

installed_environment.import_provenance: 12 packages and 6 entry points resolved from RouteB isolated application venv

scope_boundary: Synthetic identifiers and temporary SQLite only. No project research ledger was mutated; no market, account, Validation, Test, or Holdout payload was read.
